spec.title: One Pairformer block (AF3 SI Algorithm 17), repeated 48 times
spec.caption: z: N × N × 128 pair features, s: N × 384 single features. Every step is residual: it adds a correction to what is already there. The pair track goes first; the single track then reads the updated z.
spec.main_latex: (s, z) \;\mapsto\; (s, z) + \text{seven residual updates}, \qquad \text{48 blocks with separate weights}

steps.explanation: Rewrite each pair from the two edges leaving its tokens, summed over every third token. O(N³).
The same from the edges arriving at its tokens. After these two steps every pair has, in principle, heard from every other pair.

Pair (i, j) attends over the pairs (i, k) that start at the same token, 4 heads; the third edge (j, k) of each triangle sets a bias on the attention weight. Unlike multiplication, attention chooses which k to listen to. O(N³).
The same over the pairs (k, j) that end at the same token, with (k, i) as the bias edge.

steps.latex: z_{ij} \leftarrow z_{ij} + W_3\big(\mathrm{swish}(W_1 \bar z_{ij}) \odot W_2 \bar z_{ij}\big)
steps.explanation: A SwiGLU feed-forward layer, 128 → 512 → 128, applied to every pair on its own: no mixing between pairs.
Attention over tokens with 16 heads, where the pair representation adds one bias per head to every logit. This is the only place z influences s inside the block; nothing flows from s back into z.
A feed-forward layer on every token. Then the next block starts again with the triangle updates.
